name: Tok's Trap

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-07: Sewer Dragon Crisis

items.name: Ensnare
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps into the square where the trap is located

---

Effect The triggering creature's gets entangled in netting. The target must make a DC 16 Reflex save save or be Slowed 1 until they Escape the net.

text: This basic trap is little more than a snare designed to slow down and distract enemies.
